name: Live Updates and Live Activities
plain: Shows a live, ongoing status on the lock screen and status bar.
meaning: Live status cards for rides, deliveries and timers. They keep the app visible in prime screen space and are limited to defined use cases.

android.prompt_ui: Settings toggle per app; app must also opt in via requestPromotedOngoing
android.store_policy: Play: only for eligible ongoing, user-initiated activities
android.note: Protection level reported as normal|appops in AOSP; verify against the current manifest reference. Media player notifications are excluded.

ios.permission: NSSupportsLiveActivities (Info.plist); user toggle Allow Live Activities
ios.prompt_ui: Allow Live Activities toggle in Settings; no separate prompt
ios.persistence: Until revoked; activities end after 8 hours and can stay 4 more on the Lock Screen
ios.store_policy: App Review: Live Activities must show timely updates, not ads
ios.note: Dynamic Island requires iPhone 14 Pro or later.

limits.headline: Can show a live status on your lock screen, if you allow it for the app
limits.user_action: You start a ride, order, timer or trip and the app shows a live card
can: Show live progress on the lock screen and status bar
Use the Dynamic Island on iPhone 14 Pro and newer
Keep updating while the task runs
cannot: Show it if you turned off Live Activities or Live Updates for the app
Use it for anything that is not an ongoing task
Use the Dynamic Island on older iPhones
limits.differs: iPhone calls it Live Activities (iOS 16.1 and up). Android 16 calls it Live Updates. Both have a per app switch in Settings.

story.what_it_is: Lets an app show a live status card for a ride, delivery or timer on the lock screen.

marketing.name: Live Activities
marketing.pitch: Apple lets apps show live updates for tasks on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.

marketing.name: Live Updates
marketing.pitch: Google adds Live Updates in Android 16 for time bound tasks like rides and deliveries.

story.for_you: You see a live card that keeps updating, such as your driver on a map. You can switch it off per app in settings.
story.for_makers: Makers get a prime spot with strong visibility. Both systems limit it to real tasks, not ads.

use_cases.example: A food order shows live steps until it arrives.
A ride shows the car and time left.
A live match shows a running score.
A timer app keeps a countdown on the lock screen.
A flight shows delays and gate live.
A workout shows pace on the Dynamic Island.
A game shows a live match score or timer.

story.android_note: Android 16 needs a settings toggle and the app must opt in.
story.ios_note: iOS has a toggle per app. The Dynamic Island needs iPhone 14 Pro or later.

technical_bounds: Android confidence is based on secondary sources and AOSP commits

history.change: Progress-centric notifications introduced; stable lacked the permission
